context: Tests evidence-backed comparison against matching prose and the paragraph card-deck continuity check. The response must repair argument movement while protecting a dependent punchline and related ideas.

checklist.name: Matching evidence selected
checklist.description: The report names analytical opinion as the assignment mode and uses two or three supplied, solely authored passages as calibration evidence.

checklist.name: Five dimensions compared
checklist.description: The report compares pre-edit and post-edit prose on narrator presence, spoken cadence, connective paragraph flow, reader relationship, and argument movement.

checklist.name: Card-deck run diagnosed
checklist.description: The report identifies the documentation, versioning, error-design, and ownership paragraphs as independent or reorderable cards rather than merely calling them choppy.

checklist.name: Argument movement repaired
checklist.description: The revised middle carries subjects, consequences, or qualifications across paragraph boundaries so reordering the paragraphs would change the argument.

checklist.name: Punchline preserved
checklist.description: The one-line paragraph 'The interface is internal. The consequences are not.' remains isolated or equivalently punchy and still depends on the preceding argument.

checklist.name: No transition-word spray
checklist.description: The revision does not repair every paragraph with repetitive connectors such as additionally, moreover, or furthermore.

checklist.name: Related ideas may stay together
checklist.description: The revision does not mechanically split every sentence into one isolated idea and preserves relationships within a spoken thought.

checklist.name: Independent states reported
checklist.description: Mechanical sweep, manual anti-pattern review, voice calibration, and paragraph continuity each receive their own explicit state.
